title: Charlottesville, VA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Charlottesville, VA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Charlottesville is a city in VA with a population of 48,000. Home of the University of Virginia and Thomas Jefferson’s Monticello with a vibrant downtown. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.9.
